title: Page 353
transc:
No 1  9 am
Sullivan Nashville Tenn  Wash D. C. May 24 1865
& Lines Macon Ga
Topsy harrow pebble for lady embrace copy for Knight
dismal unity I want Knight to remain in Argus
which state I contemplate giving him pontiac of zebra
He will require some pacific andy shall send him
some sulphur from here to enable him to carry
out orders for mustering out whinny whose time expires
before the plunge of Oct zodiac If he can
send about plaster purple office panama tothe argyle windpipe 
they will be nutmeg for nabob pekin He might also 
send about plank waldo to avon zebra Those retained
Stephen waxy should all be spit whose time will
not expire before the plug of Oct. pedlar Whips
leghorn consolidates putting spit saxon same state together &
those sent home toby mustard out lehigh attached to
whartons returning tremble zebra He shld tambour in this
matter at once Walrus Jupiter Have sent copy both
